conditions_by_beat_id.19: Helaena physically approaches, touches, mounts, or otherwise interacts with the real Dreamfyre in the present timeline.
conditions_by_beat_id.161: Caraxes deliberately bites or grapples another dragon during an active fight.
conditions_by_beat_id.163: Vermithor burns an organized troop formation, fortification, or major battlefield target.
conditions_by_beat_id.166: Vhagar personally causes another dragon's unmistakable on-screen death.
conditions_by_beat_id.167: Daeron mounts Tessarion and the two become airborne on an active mission or in battle.
conditions_by_beat_id.171: Addam summons or mounts Seasmoke for an active mission and Seasmoke visibly responds to his command.
conditions_by_beat_id.173: Ulf directs Silverwing to attack a Black-aligned person, force, dragon, or position.
conditions_by_beat_id.175: Helaena physically rides Dreamfyre and both become airborne in the present timeline; visions do not count.
conditions_by_beat_id.176: Sheepstealer physically reappears alive in the present timeline after the episode-7 separation.
conditions_by_beat_id.180: Rhaenyra mounts Syrax and flies on an active mission, pursuit, or battle movement.

exclusions: A mention, roar, distant unconfirmed silhouette, ordinary presence, inactive mounting, transport-only flight, or preparation without the preserved physical action does not count.
A proxy dragon, rider, ally, or subordinate performing the action does not count for the named owner unless the audited condition explicitly names that command relationship.
An off-screen report, recap, dream, vision, memory, prediction, promotional image, or hypothetical version of the action does not count.
families.title_review_note: Each listed title honestly names a visible present-timeline dragon interaction, attack, flight, command response, battlefield action, death or reappearance whose full boundary remains the preserved audited condition.
